dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white baseline skin tone across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, thin, diagonal linear mark visible in the mid-body region; a faint vertical line is also present near the posterior terminus.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct linear scratch or mark is visible on the mid-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, dark oval blowhole positioned at the anterior dorsal midline.
